_comment: Config-driven 'big tournament' engine. Each entry auto-appears on the site as its
own section + nav tab when the tournament is approaching (see lead_days), stays pinned
while it is live, sticks around for a short recap, then retires itself automatically.
Nothing here needs a code change — add a row and the dashboard picks it up.
Fields:
id         unique slug (used for the DOM id + deep-link anchor)
label      display name
emoji      shown in the nav tab + section heading
blurb      one-line subtitle under the heading
start/end  YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive tournament window
lead_days  how many days BEFORE start the section appears (countdown mode)
recap_days how many days AFTER end the section lingers (results mode)
fav_teams  teams to highlight in the fixture tables
source     { type: 'espn', sport, league }  -> ESPN scoreboard API
{ type: 'local', file, match }   -> derive from an existing data/*.json
by matching the competition name
Verified ESPN rugby league IDs: 180659 Six Nations · 164205 Rugby World Cup ·
244293 The Rugby Championship · 17567 Nations Championship.
(Note 270559 is French Top 14, not the URC.) ESPN only publishes fixtures a few
months out, so an empty feed for a future tournament is expected, not a bug.
